summary: Phase 3 Progress tab verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) via Expo web preview. All 7 requested flows pass. Empty state (no workouts) renders the centered 'progress-empty-state' with the exact copy 'Log your first workout to see your progress charts!' and neither 'strength-card' nor 'muscle-card' are in the DOM. Onboarding 'No, thanks' completes and persists. After logging a single Squat 100x5 today, both 'strength-card' and 'muscle-card' appear, the empty state is gone, 'strength-chart' renders, and the muscle legend contains 'muscle-legend-legs'. Switching the Progress picker to an exercise with no data (Bench Press / Deadlift) correctly shows 'strength-chart-empty'; switching back to Squat re-renders 'strength-chart'. Logging Squat on three different dates via 'date-prev-button' (Today=100, -1d=110, -2d=90) yields a LineChart with 3 dots, labels Jun 17 / Jun 18 / Jun 19, 'Best: 110', 'Sessions: 3' — confirming per-date MAX aggregation. Adding a Bench Press 60x8 set produces a 2-wedge pie chart with exactly two legend rows: Legs 50% · 1 and Chest 50% · 1, and zero Back/Shoulders rows. Refresh-on-focus verified: logging a new Bench Press set on the Logger tab and switching back to Progress immediately reflected the new muscle-group count without an app reload (observed during the first full run; in the final consolidated run the second navigation back to Progress was thwarted by an ambiguous get_by_text('Progress') selector — see context_for_next_testing_agent). No critical or blocking issues found. Minor (non-blocking): react-native-chart-kit emits legacy event-handler / TouchableMixin / pointerEvents deprecation warnings to console — these originate inside the chart library, not app code.

react_native_issues.issue: Library is unmaintained on RN 0.81 / react-native-web and prints deprecation warnings/errors at runtime: 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents', and several 'Unknown event handler property ... onStartShouldSetResponder/onResponderGrant/onResponderMove/onResponderRelease/onResponderTerminate/onResponderTerminationRequest/onPressIn'. Not a functional blocker — charts render correctly. Source: dependency in package.json (react-native-chart-kit ^6.12.3). No app-side fix needed; consider migrating later (e.g., to victory-native or react-native-svg-charts) if these warnings cause noise in production.

critical_code_review_comments: progress.tsx correctly excludes Mongo concerns (frontend-only), uses StyleSheet, wraps all text in <Text>, has testIDs on all interactive/critical elements, and uses useFocusEffect for refresh-on-focus — implementation matches Phase 3 spec exactly.

muscle-groups.ts EXERCISE_TO_MUSCLE mapping is correct (Squat→Legs, Bench→Chest, Deadlift→Back, OHP→Shoulders, Row→Back); aggregateByMuscle correctly drops empty groups via the consumer's filter so the pie only shows non-zero wedges/legend rows.

workout-storage.ts aggregation helpers (getMaxWeightSeries, getSetCountsByExercise, hasAnySets, getAllSets) are O(n) over the date map and sort points oldest→newest by dateKey string — works because dateKey is YYYY-MM-DD, lexicographic == chronological.
seed_data_creation: Attempted to seed fit.workouts.v1 via localStorage; storage util double-JSON-encodes on write, so direct single-encoded seeds were ignored by readStore() and treated as empty. Worked around by exercising the real Logger UI to populate data (which is also a stronger end-to-end test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile viewport 390x844 used. AsyncStorage on web is plain localStorage; workout-storage.ts stringifies the Store object once, and the underlying storage util stringifies again, so localStorage holds a JSON string of a JSON string (e.g. starts with a quote). If you want to seed, double-encode: localStorage.setItem('fit.workouts.v1', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(store))). IMPORTANT for tab navigation: page.get_by_text('Progress'/'Logger').first becomes AMBIGUOUS once a screen has been mounted, because react-native-web keeps tab screens mounted and the screen heading '<Text>Progress</Text>' also matches. Prefer the tabBarTestID values 'tab-logger' / 'tab-progress' / 'tab-calendar' if reachable, or click the bottom-of-screen tab button by coordinates / role. Also, several testIDs are reused across both screens — always scope by the parent card (e.g., page.locator('[data-testid="strength-card"] [data-testid="exercise-picker-trigger"]')) when both Logger and Progress are mounted. Onboarding storage key is 'fit.onboarding.v1' (boolean stored as JSON-encoded string).
rca_of_issue: No app bugs identified. Two transient test-script issues encountered (not code defects): (a) using .first on shared testIDs picked up the Logger's still-mounted ExercisePicker instead of Progress's — fixed by scoping under [data-testid="strength-card"]; (b) get_by_text('Progress').first became ambiguous on the second navigation after the Progress screen heading was in the DOM — best mitigated by using tab-progress testID or coordinate clicks on the bottom tab bar.
